title: The Last Terminal Revisited
author: Marguerite Almeida
blurb: Mara Reyes, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
